The common order is min{1,max{(n delta^2)^(-1/2),(n delta)^(-2/7)}}, with both elbows, no logarithmic loss and consistency exactly when n delta_n^2 diverges. tldr: When treatment and adjustment variables remain public, randomized response weakens outcome information without weakening propensity information. The focal object is the all-sample-size, all-channel-strength absolute-risk frontier for the ordinary observational ATE on the supplied uniform-design H\"older class. A total multiresolution estimator must attain an evaluated numerical rate, with matching original-likelihood converses on the same class. Finite-sample honest connected intervals, their expected-length order, crossover regions and consistency conditions are companion obligations. Identification, scalar Taylor corrections, fixed-uniform mixture testing and the known-assignment endpoint receive prior-art credit.
gap: Ohnishi--Awan (2025), Section 7, leaves observational selection-bias adjustment beyond its experimental theory. Corrected Robins et al. (2017) and Chaubet--Divol (2025) provide essential higher-order machinery, but their stated results do not evaluate the supplied experiment uniformly as \(\delta\) approaches zero.
fill: The attainment question evaluates both precision bottlenecks without assuming a rate or nuisance-estimation condition. The covariance calculation counts one outcome endpoint per ordered kernel. Credited same-class mixture testing and finite-sample coverage reductions complete the precision benchmark.
